title: Target Infection
statement: A window of m consecutive integers (m up to 10^9) must hold exactly k infected positions, given n ≤ 2·10^5 disjoint sorted infected intervals with coordinates up to 10^15. Shifting the window changes the count by at most one, so an answer exists iff the best window, which starts at an interval's left end (two pointers), reaches k; binary search toward the empty right end then finds it.
